figurative_meaning_en: The main point or essence of the matter or story
example_sentences_in_bangla: লেজামুড়া বাদ দিয়ে বল, কী ঘটেছে?
গল্পের লেজামুড়া বাদ করে মূল কথাটা শোনাও।
example_sentences_in_english: Skip the twisted tail and tell me what happened.
Cut out the fluff and get to the main point of the story.
note: Refers to excluding unnecessary elaborations, like trimming the 'curled tail' of a story.
